description: Open the memorial photo catalog spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/memorial_photos_raw.xlsx. You're organizing 50 photos for a memorial service slideshow happening in 3 days. Add structured column headers (E-L) for Quality_Rating, Life_Stage, Include_in_Slideshow, Slideshow_Order, Display_Seconds, Story_Notes, Technical_Issue, and Family_Input. Set up data validation dropdowns for appropriate columns. Apply conditional formatting to highlight YES (green), NO (gray), low quality (red), and permission needed (orange). Fill in at least 15 rows with realistic data based on filenames and years. Assign sequential order numbers only to photos marked YES. Create a summary section with formulas calculating total photos, photos marked YES/MAYBE, estimated duration, photos needing permission, and average quality. Enable freeze panes on row 1 and auto-filter. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S). Read /home/ga/Documents/memorial_requirements.txt for context.
